name: Cyclizine
summary: First generation antihistamine and anticholinergic drug used to combat nausea and vomiting. Causes drowsiness. Similar to most other antihistamines, it typically induces delirium and vivid realistic hallucinations at high dosages. The drug is reported to be uncomfortable and not enjoyable at these dosages.
advisory: The provided dosages are intended for therapeutic use.
